question: Who won the 2022 World Cup?

answer:
**Argentina** won the 2022 FIFA World Cup. They beat France 3–3 (after extra time, Argentina won on penalties) in the final played on December 18, 2022, after Argentina also topped France via regulation/extra-time goals tied at 3-3 — the match record shows Argentina as the official winner.

Along the way, Argentina beat Croatia 3–0 in the semi-final, while France beat Morocco 2–0 in the other semi. Croatia took third place by defeating Morocco 2–1.

The dataset covers the 2018 and 2022 World Cups, and across both, **4 knockout matches were decided by a penalty shootout**:

| Tournament | Stage | Match | Score (90/120 min) | Penalties | Advanced |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2018 | Quarter-final | Russia vs Croatia | 2–2 | 3–4 | **Croatia** |
| 2022 | Quarter-final | Croatia vs Brazil | 1–1 | 4–2 | **Croatia** |
| 2022 | Quarter-final | Netherlands vs Argentina | 2–2 | 3–4 | **Argentina** |
| 2022 | Final | Argentina vs France | 3–3 | 4–2 | **Argentina** |

A few things stand out:
- **Croatia and Argentina each won two of these shootouts**, with Argentina's coming on the biggest stage — the 2022 final itself, where they beat France on penalties after a 3–3 draw (including extra time).
- All four shootouts happened at the quarter-final stage or later — none in earlier knockout rounds (round of 16, etc.) in this data.
- Note: the 2018 semi-final (England vs Croatia) also went to extra time, but was settled by a goal rather than penalties, so it isn't in this list.

Here's what's in the **World Cup Core** dataset (all on one PostgreSQL datasource), covering the **2018 and 2022 FIFA World Cups**:

**Core reference tables**
- **tournaments** – the 2 editions (2018 Russia, 2022 Qatar), dates, champion/runner-up
- **teams** / **countries** / **confederations** – 32-ish national teams per tournament, mapped to country and confederation (UEFA, CONMEBOL, CAF, AFC, CONCACAF)
- **venues** – stadiums, cities, capacities, linked to tournament
- **tournament_teams** – which teams played which tournament, their group, final ranking, and whether they reached the knockout stage

**Match-level data**
- **matches** – every match with stage (group/round of 16/quarter/semi/final/third-place), teams, scores, extra time & penalty results, winner, attendance
- **match_team_statistics** – per-team-per-match stats: possession, shots, shots on target, corners, fouls, offsides, passes, expected goals (xG)
- **goals** – individual goal events: scorer, assist, minute, goal type (open play, penalty, own goal, header, free kick), running score
- **disciplinary_events** – cards (yellow in the sample), reason, minute, player/team

**Player data**
- **players** – name, position, national team, date of birth
- **squad_members** – tournament roster membership, shirt number, squad position

**Pre-built convenience views**
- **v_match_results** – match results already joined to readable team/venue names
- **v_player_goal_totals** – goals/penalties/own-goals per player per tournament, with first-goal minute
- **v_seeded_team_performance** – team-level summary per tournament: wins, goals for/against, possession, shots, xG, attendance
